This identifies potential risks associated with your device and outlines robust strategies for their mitigation. 5. Quality Management System (QMS) Documentation Provide clear evidence of a robust Quality Management System (QMS), such as ISO 13485 certification. Potentially, an audit of the manufacturing facility (for Indian manufacturers) or a review of the foreign manufacturer’s quality system. 8.
